caption: A flat bag of microwave popcorn lies in a running microwave, and the bag swells and puffs up as popping begins inside.

sa.check: A flat bag of popcorn lies in a running microwave.
The bag stays flat at first.
The bag rises and rounds out.
Popping happens inside as it swells.
The pops come faster as the bag fills.
The bag stays flat before the popping starts.

pc.expect: The bag stays flat until popping starts inside it and then rises with it; it does not inflate before any pop.
pc.fail: The bag is fully puffed before any popping shows; or the bag stays flat while pops plainly shake it to the end of the clip; or the bag flattens while the popping goes on; or the bag swells with the microwave off and still.

pc.expect: The bag stays one bag whose flat sides bow out and whose folds open as it fills, keeping its printed faces.
pc.fail: The bag swells into a smooth sphere with no folds or seams; or the bag splits into separate bags; or the bag turns into another object; or the bag keeps its sharp flat creases while plainly full and round.

pc.expect: The bag rises upward off the turntable's floor as it fills and stays on the turntable.
pc.fail: The bag swells downward into the turntable; or the bag lifts off the turntable and hangs in the air; or the bag sinks as it fills; or the bag rises and sticks to the microwave's roof.

pc.expect: The bag only fills while the popping goes on and the pops grow more frequent and then ease; the bag does not deflate mid-way.
pc.fail: The bag deflates and inflates again while the popping goes on; or the popping stops and starts again with the microwave running steadily; or the bag's size jumps between frames; or the popped bag flattens to its first shape with the microwave still running.

pc.expect: One bag in one microwave; the bag stays inside and nothing passes through it.
pc.fail: Popcorn appears outside the sealed bag; or a second bag appears; or the bag passes through the microwave's door; or the bag vanishes.

pc.expect: The bag's printing, the turntable and the microwave's interior stay the same.
pc.fail: The bag's printing changes; or the turntable changes shape; or the interior changes.

note: The pops are sound; they are read from the bag jumping and from its filling.
